subject_world: material and texture, no people: woven cloth at macro, undyed cotton, indigo denim twill, raw canvas, cotton thread on spools, selvedge edges, a loom's warp under tension, morning light raking across fabric
grade_recipe: morning light on cloth: filter contrast(1.05) saturate(0.9) brightness(1.04); indigo #2B2F8F shadow overlay 8 to 14 percent mix-blend-mode lighten; butter #F6E7A1 highlight overlay 10 to 16 percent mix-blend-mode multiply; total overlay 12 to 24 percent; applied in CSS to video and img, never to product shots or the kit
